```bash

wc -l HANDOFF.md                            # total lines — drives the read-from-end offset
```

Read in parallel (HANDOFF.md uses **read-from-end strategy** — SSP-01 v6.5.0; monolítico newest-first, **~10k+ linhas e crescendo** — rode o `wc -l` do pre-flight, NÃO assuma um total fixo):
- `HANDOFF.md` with `limit=30` → FIRST ACTION FOR NEXT AGENT + o topo do Task State (a 1ª linha do Task State = a fase mais recém-selada; é o que importa).
- ⚠️ **TOKEN-CAP GUARD (aprendido 2026-07-19):** as linhas do Task State e dos Records são **parágrafos densos (2-4k chars cada)** — uma janela de 55-400 linhas pode **estourar o teto de 25k tokens do Read** e falhar. **Regra:** leia em janelas de **≤150 linhas**; se o Read retornar erro de token-cap, **corte a janela pela metade** e repita. Nunca insista numa janela grande "porque o doc manda".
- Para o Record mais recente (últimas 1-2 fases seladas): comece em `offset ≈ (total − 40)` com `limit=20` (pega a última linha do Task State) e depois leia o bloco `## … Record` mais novo em janelas ≤150 linhas subindo. As seções de sufixo (Pending Actions · GraphRAG State · Infrastructure · Key Files) ficam **no `CLAUDE.md`/`sprint-priorities`**, não no fim do HANDOFF.md — priorize aquelas.
- 📌 **Se `wc -l HANDOFF.md` > ~4000:** o arquivo está pesado demais p/ pickup eficiente — sinalize nos ALERTAS que o `/handoff` deveria **arquivar Records antigos** (ver Phase 5 do seal). Um HANDOFF.md enxuto (Task State + ~12 Records recentes) é o alvo.
- `CLAUDE.md` (architecture rules, data flow, key files — incluindo MCORCH Master Execution Protocol + Survival Laws link)
- `.claude/context/sprint-priorities.md` (sprint goal, 4Cs snapshot, top gaps)
- `/home/ubuntu/.claude/projects/-home-gcrUX-htdocs-constellation-orchestra/memory/MEMORY.md` (memory index)

> ⚠️ **Auditoria histórica de seals antigos:** usar `Read` com offset arbitrário em HANDOFF.md (fora do fluxo padrão de pickup). Ordering newest-first: seal mais antigo ≈ linha 2805, seal mais recente logo após linha 71. Cada `## <Phase> Record (YYYY-MM-DD)` marca um seal. Manter o Read em chunks ≤ 400 linhas para preservar budget de tokens.

### BoK Gate check (v3 — MCORCH Master Execution Protocol)

For each BoK suite in `docs/bok/<slug>/`, verify completeness:
```bash
for slug in $(ls docs/bok/ 2>/dev/null); do
  if [ "$slug" = "security" ]; then
    required_sec=(00-deepsearch-blueprint 01-brd-security 02-srs-secure-spec 03-sdd-hardening-architecture 04-fmea-security)
    missing=()
    for doc in "${required_sec[@]}"; do
      [ -f "docs/bok/security/$doc.md" ] || missing+=("$doc")
    done
    [ ${#missing[@]} -eq 0 ] && echo "✅ security — BoK complete (ciso-4-artifact)" || echo "⚠️ security — missing: ${missing[*]}"
    continue
  fi
  required=(00-index 01-mrd 02-brd 03-prd 04-frd 05-sdd 06-data-model 07-process-flow 08-quality-metrics)
  missing=()
  for doc in "${required[@]}"; do
    [ -f "docs/bok/$slug/$doc.md" ] || missing+=("$doc")
  done
  [ ${#missing[@]} -eq 0 ] && echo "✅ $slug — BoK complete" || echo "⚠️ $slug — missing: ${missing[*]}"
done
```

If the user mentions working on a **new module / complex feature / integration / architectural change**:
- Check whether `docs/bok/<expected-slug>/` exists with all 9 docs.
- If missing: surface in the **ALERTAS** section as a critical block per CLAUDE.md MCORCH Master Execution Protocol.
- Recommend `/bok-scribe <idea summary>` before any code is written.

## Fase 7 (opcional) — PMO handoff (`pmo-curator`)

Depois de entregar o brief, **ofereça** disparar o PMO tático: a skill `pmo-curator` lê o mesmo estado, aplica MAPE-K de PROGRESSO e materializa os próximos passos priorizados em `NEXT-STEPS.md` (un-gated vs gated, dependências, deadlines, comando exato de cada passo executável).

- **Quando oferecer:** sempre que o Sovereign, após o brief, pedir "os próximos passos / o que atacar primeiro / priorize o backlog / gere o plano".
- **Como:** invocar a skill `pmo-curator` (ou delegar ao subagente homônimo). Ela é **plan-only** — não executa nada.
- **Fronteira:** o `pmo-curator` é o loop de PROGRESSO; **não** é o guardião MAPE-K (loop de confiabilidade — infra/incidentes). SOP: `docs/processes/pmo-curator.md`.

Não force — o `/handson` continua entregando o brief como sempre; o PMO é uma camada de planejamento opcional por cima.

## Rules

- **TypeScript errors → report immediately.** If there are TS errors, list them under ALERTAS. Do not start implementing new features until errors are resolved (unless the user explicitly asks to proceed despite errors).
- **Unhealthy containers → report with triage.** Suggest the fix command if known (e.g., `docker compose restart mcorch-vector-engine` for chroma).
- **Uncommitted changes → describe, do not commit.** Only describe what exists in the working tree; committing is the user's call.
- **Keep the brief tight.** No padding. No repetition of CLAUDE.md architecture. The user already knows the architecture — they need the delta: what changed, what's broken, what's next.
- **Pending Actions priority order:** CRITICAL (before first client) > NON-CRITICAL > Phase Zeta > Core v3 > Epsilon v9.
- **Knowledge Mesh numbers:** use `GraphRAG State` section from HANDOFF.md as the source. Do not invent counts.

> 61	Arco 3 (**4 refinamentos do Canvas UX** direcionados por prints do Sovereign): (a) edges INVISÍVEIS em zoom-out porque ReactFlow escala SVG por `transform:scale(zoom)` → strokeWidth de 2px vira 0.03px na tela em zoom=0.02. Fix: CSS var `--rf-zoom-inv` no wrapper via `onMove` callback + edges usando `strokeWidth: calc(base * var(...))` — zero rerender React. (b) `fitView` do ReactFlow atropelava `defaultViewport` → cards touching. Fix: `fitView` só quando `!project.viewport || é o default (0,0,1)` — projetos com viewport intencional respeitam o preset salvo. (c) Cards custom ~280-300px "travavam" na lane de 320px (só 20px de margem). Fix: `LANE_HEIGHT` 320→480 (comentário explica impacto nos 3 projetos com pipelineMode). (d) 22 lanes vazias visualmente ("faltando"): workflow `wf_c998bd99` (3 agentes: extractor 48 cenas → adversarial critic → synth) populou `graph.lanes: LaneConfig[]` com 48 labels rotulados cena-a-cena (`"3 · S · Curta final 9:16 fullscreen"`, PASS 0 blockers 2 NITs corrigidos), max 42 chars, ficando visíveis.

<details>
<summary>💭 Thinking Process</summary>

I'm seeing how the `imageToVideo` node works with the Veo provider—it constructs a payload with the node type, provider, model, and prompt, then adds either reference image URLs for presenter mode or an input asset URL for b-roll mode before sending it to canvas-execute.

For `generateImage` with Nano Banana, it's a simpler synchronous flow through canvas-execute that returns the output URL directly. But `voiceClone` is fundamentally different—it returns null from `resolveExecutePayload`, which means it bypasses canvas-execute entirely and instead gets triggered through the VoiceCloneInspector, which calls the voice synthesis edge function and polls the video renders queue for completion.

This is the key insight: the Run All pipeline doesn't actually generate the voice narrations, so those six narrations need to be dispatched separately through the generate-voice path. I need to trace through useAvatarVoice.ts to understand the contract for that synthesize flow, then build a runner that handles three distinct dispatch paths—one for generateImage, one for imageToVideo, and one for voiceClone.

</details>

- `voiceClone` → `resolveExecutePayload` retorna **null** → vai por `generate-voice` (async 202 → poll `video_renders`), **NÃO** pelo Run All

The video assembly succeeded with all 48 segments normalized and concatenated into a 6.2-minute file, but the audio mux is failing because I created the video without an audio stream using `-an`, so when the filter tries to reference the video's audio track, there's nothing there. The narration audio indices are also misaligned since I'm treating input 0 as having audio when it doesn't.

The fix is straightforward: the narrations are actually ffmpeg inputs 1 through 6 (input 0 is the video), so I need to adjust the adelay filter to reference `[1:a]`, `[2:a]`, etc., and use the correct input indices when mixing. The offsets I calculated (0ms, 43s, 98s, 169s, 255s, 327s) are correct for the act boundaries, so I just need to rewrite the audio mux command with the proper input indexing and run it against the existing video file.

PAD_ANTES_S) * SR)\n            ib = int(min(tl.duracao_s, t0 + b + PAD_DEPOIS_S) * SR)\n            if ib > ia:\n                m[ia:ib] = True\n                palavras += 1\n    lim = int(VAO_MIN_S * SR)                    # fecha vãos curtos demais\n    idx = np.flatnonzero(np.diff(m.astype(np.int8)))\n    for k in range(len(idx) - 1):\n        if not m[idx[k] + 1] and (idx[k + 1] - idx[k]) < lim:\n            m[idx[k] + 1: idx[k + 1] + 1] = True\n    return m, palavras\n\n\ndef envelope(mask):\n    """máscara -> ganho suave (ataque/release de 1ª ordem)"""\n    alvo = np.where(mask, 10 ** (DUCK_DB / 20), 1.0).astype(np.float32)\n    g = np.empty_like(alvo)\n    ca = 1.0 - len(mus)), (0, 0)))\n    mus = mus[:n]\n\n    mask, pal = mascara_de_fala(tl, timings)\n    cob = 100.0 * mask.mean()\n    print(tl.resumo())\n    print()\n    print("narração cobre %.1f%% do filme (%d palavras)" % (cob, pal))\n    print("vãos livres p/ a trilha respirar: %.1f%% = %.1fs" % (100 - cob, (1 - mask.mean()) * n / SR))\n    print("ducking: %.1f dB | ataque %.0f ms | release %.0f ms" % (\n        DUCK_DB, ATAQUE_S * 1000, RELEASE_S * 1000))\n\n    duck = mus * (10 ** (a.nivel_db / 20)) * envelope(mask)[:, None]\n    duck = np.clip(duck, -1.0, 1.0)\n    with wave.open(a.saida, "wb") as w:\n        w.setnchannels(2); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(SR)\n        w.writeframes((duck * 32767).astype("<i2").tobytes())\n    frames = round(len(duck) / SR * tl.fps)\n    print("\\n-> %s   %d frames %s" % (\n        a.saida, frames, "[CONFERE com a timeline]" if frames == tl.duracao_frames else "[!! Escrever uma string nela **DESTRÓI a\n   camada** — o DOM continuava lendo o texto novo e o render não desenhava nada.\nAqui o texto é código: ninguém digita nada, e o conteúdo vive versionado no manifesto.\n\nffmpeg desta máquina **não tem `drawtext`** (não foi compilado com freetype) — o texto é\nrenderizado com PIL e o ffmpeg só compõe/rola/codifica.\n\nUso:\n    python3 gerar_creditos.py --ep ep03 --saida "EP03 - creditos.mov"\n"""\nimport argparse\nimport json\nimport os\nimport subprocess\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont\n\nfrom timeline import REPO\n\nW, H, FPS = 1920, 1080, 24\nFONTES = "/mnt/c/Windows/Fonts"\nSERIF = os.path.join(FONTES, "times.ttf")\nSERIF_ITAL = os.path.join(FONTES, "timesi.ttf")\n\nBRANCO = (232, 230, 226)\nCINZA = (150, 148, 144)\nOURO = (198, 166, 100)\n\n# (fonte, tamanho, cor, entressaco, altura da linha) — casa com a família "Film" da Adobe\nESTILO = {\n    "titulo":    (SERIF,      86, BRANCO, 18, 118),\n    "subtitulo": (SERIF,      54, BRANCO, 10, 74),\n    "legenda":   (SERIF_ITAL, 30, CINZA,   2, 46),\n    "secao":     (SERIF,      24, OURO,    7, 40),\n    "nome":      (SERIF,      36, BRANCO,  1, 50),\n    "nota":      (SERIF_ITAL, 27, CINZA,   1, 42),\n    "ref_t":     (SERIF,      28, OURO,    4, 44),\n    "ref":       (SERIF,      26, CINZA,   1, 40),\n}\n\n# Velocidade de rolagem confortável. A 1ª versão do EP03 saiu a 153 px/s e as REFERÊNCIAS —\n# que são o ponto de creditá-las — ficaram apertadas. ~125 px/s é o alvo.\nPX_S_ALVO = 125\n\n\ndef espacado(d, y, txt, fonte, tam, cor, esp):\n    f = ImageFont.truetype(fonte, tam)\n    larg = sum(f.getlength(c) + esp for c in txt) - esp\n    x = (W - larg) / 2\n    for c in txt:\n        d.text((x, y), c, font=f, fill=cor)\n        x += f.getlength(c) + esp\n\n\ndef rolagem(blocos):\n    y = sum(v if t == "esp" else ESTILO[t][4] for t, v in blocos)\n    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, y + H), (0, 0, 0))\n    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)\n    y = H                                    # começa fora da tela (embaixo)\n    for t, v in blocos:\n        if t == "esp":\n            y += v\n            continue\n        fonte, tam, cor, esp, lh = ESTILO[t]\n        espacado(d, y, v, fonte, tam, cor, esp)\n        y += lh\n    return img\n\n\ndef cartela(linhas, tmp, nome):\n    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), (0, 0, 0))\n    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)\n    total = sum(ESTILO[t][4] for t, _ in linhas)\n    y = (H - total) / 2\n    for t, txt in linhas:\n        fonte, tam, cor, esp, lh = ESTILO[t]\n        espacado(d, y, txt, fonte, tam, cor, esp)\n        y += lh\n    p = os.path.join(tmp, nome)\n    img.save(p)\n    return p\n\n\ndef main():\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument("--ep", required=True)\n    ap.add_argument("--saida", required=True)\n    a = ap.parse_args()\n    ep = json.load(open(os.path.join(REPO, "episodios", "%s.json" % a.ep), encoding="utf-8"))\n    C = ep["creditos"]\n\n    tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()\n    rol = rolagem([tuple(b) for b in C["blocos"]])\n    prol = os.path.join(tmp, "rolagem.png")\n    rol.save(prol)\n    nf = C["rolagem_frames"]\n    px_s = (rol.height - H) / (nf / FPS)\n    print("rolagem: %dx%d — %d px em %.1fs = %.0f px/s%s" % (\n        rol.width, rol.height, rol.height - H, nf / FPS, px_s,\n        "   ⚠️ rápido demais p/ ler (alvo ~%d)" % PX_S_ALVO if px_s > PX_S_ALVO * 1.15 else ""))\n\n    partes = []\n    dur = nf / FPS\n    p1 = os.path.join(tmp, "p1.mov")\n    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-y", "-loop", "1", "-framerate", str(FPS),\n                    "-t", "%.5f" % dur, "-i", prol,\n                    "-vf", "crop=%d:%d:0:\'(ih-%d)*t/%.5f\',fade=in:0:24,fade=out:st=%.3f:d=1,format=yuv420p"\n                           % (W, H, H, dur, dur - 1),\n                    "-r", str(FPS), "-c:v", "libx264", "-crf", "16", "-preset", "medium", p1], check=True)\n    partes.append(p1)\n\n    cards = [\n        (cartela([("subtitulo", l) for l in C["eco"]], tmp, "eco.png"), C["eco_frames"]),\n        (cartela([("secao", "NO PRÓXIMO EPISÓDIO"), ("nome", C["teaser"])], tmp, "teaser.png"),\n         C["teaser_frames"]),\n        (cartela([("titulo", C["assinatura"])], tmp, "assinatura.png"), C["assinatura_frames"]),\n    ]\n    for k, (png, n) in enumerate(cards):\n        p = os.path.join(tmp, "p%d.mov" % (k + 2))\n        d2 = n / FPS\n        subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-y", "-loop", "1", "-framerate", str(FPS),\n                        "-t", "%.5f" % d2, "-i", png,\n                        "-vf", "fade=in:0:12,fade=out:st=%.3f:d=0.5,format=yuv420p" % max(d2 - 0.5, 0.1),\n                        "-r", str(FPS), "-c:v", "libx264", "-crf", "16", "-preset", "medium", p], check=True)\n        partes.append(p)\n\n    lst = os.path.join(tmp, "lista.txt")\n    with open(lst, "w") as f:\n        for p in partes:\n            f.write("file \'%s\'\\n" % p)\n    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-y", "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0",\n                    "-i", lst, "-c", "copy", a.saida], check=True)\n\n    total = nf + sum(n for _, n in cards)\n    got = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0", "-show_entries",\n                          "stream=nb_frames", "-of", "csv=p=0", a.saida],\n                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()\n    print("-> %s   %s frames (esperado %d = %.2fs)" % (a.saida, got, total, total / FPS))\n    print("   os últimos %.0fs são a ZONA DOS CARDS de fim de vídeo do YouTube — deixe-a calma."\n          % (C["assinatura_frames"] / FPS))\n\n\nif __name__ == "__main__":\n    main()\n'}]

```json
  "content": "/**\n * Deterministic HyperFrames-style render of title.html: GSAP timeline seeked per frame \u2192 PNG \u2192 MP4.\n * 10s @ 30fps = 300 frames, 1280\u00d7720. Output: title10s.mp4.\n */\nimport { chromium } from 'playwright';\nimport { execSync } from 'child_process';\nconst DIR = '/tmp/claude-1001/-home-gcrUX-htdocs-constellation-orchestra/2cf8e553-9753-4c9c-9148-90a20004effe/scratchpad/title';\nconst CHROME = '/home/ubuntu/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1226/chrome-linux/chrome';\nconst FPS = 30, DUR = 10, N = FPS * DUR;\nexecSync(`mkdir -p ${DIR}/frames && rm -f ${DIR}/frames/*.png`);\n\nconst browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true, executablePath: CHROME });\nconst page = await (await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1280, height: 720 }, deviceScaleFactor: 1 })).newPage();\nawait page.goto(`file://${DIR}/title.html`, { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 30000 });\nawait page.waitForFunction(() => (window as any).__seek && (window as any).gsap, null, { timeout: 15000 });\nawait page.waitForTimeout(300);\n\nfor (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {\n  const t = i / FPS;\n  await page.evaluate((tt) => (window as any).__seek(tt), t);\n  await page.screenshot({ path: `${DIR}/frames/f_${String(i).padStart(4, '0')}.png`, animations: 'disabled' });\n}\nawait browser.close();\nconsole.log(`${N} frames captured`);\n\nexecSync(`ffmpeg -y -framerate ${FPS} -i ${DIR}/frames/f_%04d.png -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 16 -preset medium -r ${FPS} ${DIR}/title10s.mp4 -loglevel error`);\nconsole.log('title10s.mp4 built');\nexecSync(`for t in 2 5 7; do ffmpeg -y -ss $t -i ${DIR}/title10s.mp4 -frames:v 1 ${DIR}/qa_$t.jpg -loglevel error; done`);\nconsole.log('QA frames at 2/5/7s ready');\n"
}
```

**Verify any significant module work in this session has a sealed BoK suite per CLAUDE.md MCORCH Master Execution Protocol.**

```bash
# 6-1. List BoK suites present + check completeness
for slug in $(ls docs/bok/ 2>/dev/null); do
  required=(00-index 01-mrd 02-brd 03-prd 04-frd 05-sdd 06-data-model 07-process-flow 08-quality-metrics)
  missing=()

  [ ${#missing[@]} -eq 0 ] \
    && echo "✅ $slug — BoK complete (9 docs)" \
    || echo "⚠️ $slug — incomplete (missing: ${missing[*]})"
done

# 6-2. Check session touched code in new src/pages/ or new supabase/functions/ that lacks BoK
session_new_modules=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~10..HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^(src/pages/|supabase/functions/|src/components/[A-Z])" | awk -F/ '{print $1"/"$2}' | sort -u)

fi
```
